name: look-up
description: Double-click any word to see what it means, without leaving the page.

scripts.test: node tools/render.mjs && node tools/probe.mjs && node build.mjs && node tools/smoke.mjs
scripts.package:firefox: node build.mjs firefox && cd dist/firefox && zip -r -FS ../../web-ext-artifacts/look-up-firefox.zip . -x '.*'
scripts.package:chrome: node build.mjs chrome && cd dist/chrome && zip -r -FS ../../web-ext-artifacts/look-up-chrome.zip . -x '.*'
scripts.package:source: zip -r -FS web-ext-artifacts/look-up-source.zip src tools build.mjs package.json README.md LICENSE -x '.*'
